```sql
with weeks as (
    select week_start::date as week_start
    from generate_series(date '2026-07-13', date '2026-09-01', interval 7 day) as t(week_start)
),
fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'GBP'
),
captures as (
    select a.attempt_id,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           date_trunc('week', a.business_date)::date as week_start,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.country_code = 'GB'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-07-13' and date '2026-09-06'
),
weekly as (
    select c.week_start,
           cast(round(sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)) as bigint) as value
    from captures c
    join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
    group by c.week_start
)
select cast(w.week_start as varchar) as key,
       coalesce(weekly.value, 0) as value
from weeks w
left join weekly on weekly.week_start = w.week_start
order by w.week_start
```
